meetings.title: 4th Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today’s meeting committee discussed the annual reports from the Maldivian mission in Thailand, Tokyo, New Delhi, Thiruvananthapuram, and Pakistan. South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain proposed the following proposal, and Kendhikulhudhoo Constituency Member Mohammed Afu Hamid seconded that the sub-committee should refer the twelve annual reports to the Foreign Relations Committee. It can be challenging to determine from the information provided by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs during the Foreign Relations Committee meeting on July 1, 2024. It is unidentified what the Ministry aims to accomplish in 2024. And the Ministry's 2023 goals lack information on the challenges that were faced in accomplishing the objectives along with what may be done to improve them. Since the Auditor General's Office attended the meeting, a letter should be written to the Committee requesting them to identify problems observed throughout the meeting that need to be improved in the annual reports. Then the members voted on this proposal and unanimously passed to submit the Sub-Committee's findings and twelve revised annual reports to the Foreign Relations Committee.

North Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ibrahim Muhammad proposed to extend the deadline till 15 th August 2024 and it was seconded by Maradhoo Constituency Member Ahmed Didi. Hence, the proposal to extend the deadline of to 15 August 2024 was passed by the consensus of the present members voted.

meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today's meeting, the agenda was the election of the committee chairperson and deputy chairperson of the committee. Deputy Director of Legal Affairs Shiraza Naseer conducted the election of the Chairperson and Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. North Kulhudhuffushi Constituency Member Mohamed Dawood proposed to elect Mathiveri Constituency Member Hassan Zareer as the Chairperson of the Committee. It was seconded by. North Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ibrahim Muhammad. The proposal to elect Mathiveri Constituency Member Hassan Zareer as the Chairperson of the Committee was passed unanimously. North Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ibrahim Muhammad proposed to elect South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain as the Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. It was seconded by Vaikaradhoo Constituency Hussain Ziyad. Hence, the proposal to elect South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain as the Deputy Chairperson of the Committee was passed unanimously. Then, the committee discussed a deadline for the committee to complete its work. Kendhikulhudhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Afoo Hamid proposed to complete the work by July 31, 2024. It was seconded by Maradhoo Constituency Member Ahmed Didi. (The motion was passed without a vote, as the members of the committee did not object to it.)
